findings.description: Round-1 major finding NOT resolved. The new creative row is no longer preset, but it is confounded. On contact, the vanilla enter_the_nether criterion (+1) pushed the count to the threshold (224), and the plugin unlocked enter_nether before the dimension change in the same tick. The crossing therefore happened with the ability unlocked, so the row cannot show that creative bypasses a locked Nether portal. The judge does not catch this because INVALID_SCORE_DRIFT_DURING_ACTION is only applied to LOCKED_PHASES. Margin 1 is not enough when story/enter_the_nether is unearned. A valid rerun needs that advancement pre-earned (as it was in campaign31) or a margin of at least 2, plus a check that the count stayed below the threshold until the WORLD_CHANGE.

The survival op walks through the thin portal and ends at z=-1.439, outside block z=-1, after touching it for only a few ticks. Vanilla needs 80 ticks inside a Nether portal, so the player would not have left the overworld even without any guard. There is no overlay at the samples and no explicit decision line. This row supersedes the campaign31 op row, in which the op stood in the portal about 150 ticks and the overlay was shown. The new fixture should keep the player inside the portal for more than 80 ticks after stepping in, or the campaign31 op row should be kept.
